cases.input: An overloaded application service duplicates domain rules and accesses infrastructure directly. Prove the coupling, identify a stable domain boundary, and recommend one bounded extraction with acceptance evidence.
requiredBehaviors: prove coupling with dependency and domain evidence
recommend one bounded extraction with benefit risk rollback and verification
forbiddenBehaviors: infer the target boundary only from folders or naming

cases.input: A small codebase is intentionally simple and remains easy to change. Record the flat structure, test whether deeper layering would improve changeability, and recommend no structural change when evidence is absent.
requiredBehaviors: require actual change pressure before adding abstractions
forbiddenBehaviors: add layers solely to match a preferred architecture style
treat flat structure alone as a defect

cases.input: The proposed review recommends a new framework and a broad layered rewrite based only on file layout, without dependency evidence, domain invariants, or delivery constraints.
requiredBehaviors: limit execution to at most one bounded deepening step
forbiddenBehaviors: recommend Clean Architecture or DDD by default
ignore migration security compatibility or delivery constraints
